The '''Sanctum Celestial''' was a large, heptagonal-shaped [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] had constructed in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Xakrea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. It was flooded and damaged during the [[Battle of Darkknell]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].
